chapters.text: This is a separate engineering instance. The cases, quantities and coordinate probe boxes are not commercial records or farms.
Upload a labelled document. The deterministic label parser is not AI. Each proposed field quotes its source.
Accept the quoted fields and enter the remaining engineering details. No official operator identity is represented.
Inspect the parsed preview of A1_ENGINEERING_TEST_sources.csv. Confirming makes this version active.
Inspect the parsed preview of ENGINEERING_TEST_missing_boundary.geojson. Confirming makes this version active.
A missing plot boundary holds the case. Follow the finding to the exact source row.
The source row references the missing plot. These are declared engineering quantities.
Inspect the parsed preview of A2_ENGINEERING_TEST_plots.geojson. Confirming makes this version active.
Inspect real pinned Hansen and JRC pixels inside a coordinate probe box. The shape is not a farm.
Generate the supplier evidence request from outstanding findings. The download is a real PDF.
Open the generated supplier request PDF. It asks for evidence and does not certify compliance.
Attach clearly labelled engineering evidence and record a rationale. A real review would need relevant independent records.
Reserve the declared allocation in the database ledger. No blockchain transaction is sent in this recording.
Sign off the exact evidence snapshot. This remains a reviewed draft, never an official submission.
Export a DDS XML draft only after sign-off and schema validation. No official reference number is invented.
Change the evidence. Earlier sign-off and documents become out of date; XML export is blocked until a new review.
